text: Hey people ops, quick q: what are the actual password rules again? I need to reset mine and can't remember if it's 12 or 14 chars, and do I need a special character?

Hi Derek! It's 14 characters minimum, and you need at least one uppercase, one lowercase, a number, and a special character. Also, can't reuse your last 6 passwords. It's all in the Password & MFA Requirements doc if you need more details.
Perfect, thanks Ava! I'll check the doc if I get stuck. Appreciate it.
